source_artifacts.dense_replay_RESULT.json: read from pinned main artifact; exact blob identity recorded in GitHub tree

inputs: Ten manually transcribed, selected HUD samples from the retained 2x video; preserve their values, game clocks, phases and image digests exactly as listed in fixture.json. These are not a dense numeric health/ammo series.

protocol.invalidity_rule: first sampled health value strictly below hard_minimum; equality remains valid
protocol.ammo_guard: Not replayed: selected ammo values are sparse and cannot prove paired per-monitor behavior or exclude an unsampled transient below floor 1.

decision_rule: Report first observed below-floor sample for each frozen hypothetical threshold pair. Label whether it is inside the sampled pending interval (<=56.2) or at/after the observed return boundary (>=56.4). Do not infer actual V39 behavior, continuous crossing time, or operational threshold adequacy.
